title: Financial Advisor, built with brainfreeze studio
summary: The Financial Advisor agent on real SharePoint lists that hold the workshop's synthetic records, with its own managed app. Easy mode has brainfreeze studio build all of it; Manual mode builds the same thing by hand.

easy.title: Easy mode: brainfreeze studio builds it

steps.title: Get the tools and sign in once
steps.action: Clone the library, get brainfreeze studio from your workshop host (it has no public download yet), install Microsoft's managed apps CLI, and sign in with the account that can make agents and apps in your environment.
steps.expected: The library is cloned, `python3 -m brainfreeze_studio --help` lists its commands, `ms auth status` shows your account, and `az account show` shows your tenant.

steps.title: Build and deploy everything with one command
steps.action: Run brainfreeze studio's AIBAST command for this workshop, with your SharePoint site and your environment.
steps.expected: It prints the 4 lists it made and filled, the Draft agent it deployed, and the managed app's play link. The first run opens one browser sign-in for the app's repository.

steps.title: See the synthetic records in SharePoint
steps.action: Open the site and the Financial Advisor Client Portfolios list.
steps.expected: 3 fictional records, including Robert & Susan Whitfield (ClientPortfolioId CLI-3001), with Advisor James Morrison, CFP.

steps.title: Open the Draft agent in Copilot Studio
steps.action: Open Financial Advisor Studio and review its inventory.
steps.expected: The studio instructions, 6 skills, 1 rules knowledge file(s) and 4 SharePoint Get items tools; no web search; Draft, not published.

steps.title: Test: Branch Banker
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Who is waiting, what do they need, and where should I route them after identity checks?
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: CLI-3001; No identity. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Advisory Director
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Summarize the advisor book and show which client is already retired.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: CLI-3003; Retired. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Financial Advisor
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Show the Whitfield allocation drift before our review meeting.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Robert & Susan Whitfield; Cash & Equivalents. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Financial Advisor
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Prepare discussion candidates for Angela without giving advice or creating an order.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Angela Martinez; not recommendations. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Compliance Officer
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Which client requires senior-investor controls, and what other checkpoints apply?
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: CLI-3003; Senior investor. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Branch Banker
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Draft the Whitfield handoff with request, identity status, risk context, and compliance flags.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Robert & Susan Whitfield; no case transfer. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Open the managed app
steps.action: Open the play link brainfreeze studio printed, and allow the app to use your SharePoint connection the first time.
steps.expected: Financial Advisor: 4 read-only tabs from the same lists. 3 fictional records, including Robert & Susan Whitfield (ClientPortfolioId CLI-3001), with Advisor James Morrison, CFP.

steps.title: Open a SharePoint site for the workshop data
steps.action: Use a SharePoint site you can edit, or create one (SharePoint start page, Create site, Communication site) named AIBAST Synthetic Data Manual.
steps.expected: The site's home page opens and you can create lists on it.

steps.title: Create Financial Advisor Client Portfolios from its CSV
steps.action: On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload client-portfolios.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set ClientPortfolioId, Advisor, RiskProfile, LastReview to Single line of text. Keep dates as ISO text, not Date and time; years and numeric-looking identifiers stay text (2022, not 2,022). Keep Age, RetirementTarget, TotalAssets, HoldingsUsEquitiesValue, HoldingsUsEquitiesAllocation, HoldingsUsEquitiesTarget, HoldingsInternationalEqui5b27968, HoldingsInternationalEqui1195a93, HoldingsInternationalEquid1a09d2, HoldingsFixedIncomeValue, HoldingsFixedIncomeAllocation, HoldingsFixedIncomeTarget, HoldingsRealEstateReitsValue, HoldingsRealEstateReitsAl223b61b, HoldingsRealEstateReitsTarget, HoldingsAlternativesValue, HoldingsAlternativesAllocation, HoldingsAlternativesTarget, HoldingsCashEquivalentsValue, HoldingsCashEquivalentsAl50dc5ca, HoldingsCashEquivalentsTarget, AnnualIncome, AnnualContributions, HoldingsEmergingMarketsValue, HoldingsEmergingMarketsAl6e9d949, HoldingsEmergingMarketsTarget, HoldingsMunicipalBondsValue, HoldingsMunicipalBondsAllocation, HoldingsMunicipalBondsTarget as Number. Name the list Financial Advisor Client Portfolios. Preserve the CSV column order.
steps.expected: 3 fictional records, including Robert & Susan Whitfield (ClientPortfolioId CLI-3001), with Advisor James Morrison, CFP.

steps.title: Create Financial Advisor Investment Recommendations from its CSV
steps.action: On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload investment-recommendations.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set InvestmentRecommendationId to Single line of text. Keep dates as ISO text, not Date and time; years and numeric-looking identifiers stay text (2022, not 2,022). Use Multiple lines of text for Value (up to 337 characters). If the import screen cannot create these long-text columns losslessly, stop and report the import limitation; do not continue with truncated records. Compare their full values with the downloaded CSV. Name the list Financial Advisor Investment Recommendations. Preserve the CSV column order.
steps.expected: 3 fictional records, including moderate (InvestmentRecommendationId moderate).

steps.title: Create Financial Advisor Compliance Rules from its CSV
steps.action: On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload compliance-rules.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set ComplianceRuleId, Description, AppliesTo to Single line of text. Keep dates as ISO text, not Date and time; years and numeric-looking identifiers stay text (2022, not 2,022). Name the list Financial Advisor Compliance Rules. Preserve the CSV column order.
steps.expected: 5 fictional records, including Regulation Best Interest (ComplianceRuleId reg_bi), with Description Ensure recommendations are in client's best interest.

steps.title: Create Financial Advisor Service Requests from its CSV
steps.action: On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload service-requests.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set ServiceRequestId, Request, Verification, Route to Single line of text. Keep dates as ISO text, not Date and time; years and numeric-looking identifiers stay text (2022, not 2,022). Name the list Financial Advisor Service Requests. Preserve the CSV column order.
steps.expected: 3 fictional records, including CLI-3001 (ServiceRequestId CLI-3001), with Request retirement review.

steps.title: Create a blank agent
steps.action: In Copilot Studio, create a new agent and skip the description flow.
steps.expected: A new, empty agent opens on its Build page.

steps.title: Name the agent
steps.action: Rename it Fin Advisor Studio Manual. (Agent names can be at most 30 characters.)
steps.expected: The name shows at the top of the Build page.

steps.title: Paste the studio instructions
steps.action: Copy the whole instructions file and paste it into Instructions, replacing anything there.
steps.expected: The studio instructions name the 4 list tools and map every Title and field_N column.

steps.title: Save, and check the instructions stayed
steps.action: Save, go back to the agents list, and reopen the agent.
steps.expected: The same instructions are there after reopening.

steps.title: Remove web search
steps.action: In Knowledge, remove Search all websites.
steps.expected: No web search knowledge remains.

steps.title: Add the rules-and-controls knowledge
steps.action: Knowledge, Add, upload aibast_financial-advisor-copilot-controls-and-review.md, and wait until ready. Do not upload the synthetic-records file: those records come from the list tools.
steps.expected: 1 rules knowledge file(s) listed as ready.

steps.title: Add the client portfolios tool
steps.action: Tools, Add a tool, SharePoint, Get items. Set Site Address to your site and List Name to Financial Advisor Client Portfolios; name the tool Get client portfolio records.
steps.expected: Get client portfolio records is listed under Tools.

steps.title: Add the investment recommendations tool
steps.action: Tools, Add a tool, SharePoint, Get items. Set Site Address to your site and List Name to Financial Advisor Investment Recommendations; name the tool Get investment recommendation records.
steps.expected: Get investment recommendation records is listed under Tools.

steps.title: Add the compliance rules tool
steps.action: Tools, Add a tool, SharePoint, Get items. Set Site Address to your site and List Name to Financial Advisor Compliance Rules; name the tool Get compliance rule records.
steps.expected: Get compliance rule records is listed under Tools.

steps.title: Add the service requests tool
steps.action: Tools, Add a tool, SharePoint, Get items. Set Site Address to your site and List Name to Financial Advisor Service Requests; name the tool Get service request records.
steps.expected: Get service request records is listed under Tools.

steps.title: Add the 6 skills
steps.action: Skills, Add, and upload each studio SKILL.md from the downloads.
steps.expected: 6 skills listed, with their frontmatter names.

steps.title: Review the agent
steps.action: Check the model, 6 skills, the rules knowledge and 4 tools.
steps.expected: Sonnet 4.6, 6 skills, 1 knowledge file(s), 4 Get items tools, no web search, nothing else.

steps.title: Confirm the agent is a Draft
steps.action: Check the agent's status; do not publish.
steps.expected: Draft; Publish was never selected.

steps.title: Get the app's source and set your site
steps.action: Generate the workshop's app folder, and set site in its src/config.ts to your SharePoint site.
steps.expected: financial-advisor-copilot-app/managed-app holds a React + Vite managed app whose config names your site and the 4 lists.

steps.title: Register the app and connect the lists
steps.action: In that folder, register the app with Microsoft's CLI and bind each list with your SharePoint connection.
commands: ms app init --display-name "Financial Advisor Workspace Manual" --repo native
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Financial Advisor Client Portfolios" --use-sso
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Financial Advisor Investment Recommendations" --use-sso
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Financial Advisor Compliance Rules" --use-sso
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Financial Advisor Service Requests" --use-sso
steps.expected: ms.config.json lists one SharePoint connection with the 4 tables, and generated/services has a service for each list.

steps.title: Build, push and deploy
steps.action: Build it, commit it, push it to the app's repository and deploy it.
commands: git add -A && git commit -m "Financial Advisor Workspace"
steps.expected: ms app deploy prints the app's play link.

steps.title: Open the app and compare it with the agent
steps.action: Open the play link, allow the SharePoint connection the first time, and open the Financial Advisor Client Portfolios tab.
steps.expected: The app and the agent read the same synthetic records. 3 fictional records, including Robert & Susan Whitfield (ClientPortfolioId CLI-3001), with Advisor James Morrison, CFP.
